description: Source code for the DataCapture plugin in the WPEFramework, implementing audio capture and upload functionalities, including IARM event handling, socket communication, and cURL-based data upload.

classes.name: DataCapture
classes.description: Main class implementing audio data capture, event handling, and data upload functionalities.

methods.name: enableAudioCapture
methods.description: Enables audio capture with specified buffer duration, manages session lifecycle.

methods.name: getAudioClip
methods.description: Requests an audio clip based on parameters, manages capture process.

methods.name: uploadDataToUrl
methods.description: Uploads captured audio data to specified URL using cURL.
